summary_en: Tender offer purchase target revised to 9,286,037 shares (minimum 3,768,300 shares) at ¥4,790/share. NEC pledged not to tender its CE Holdings shares; EM Systems and Nippon Jiki agreed to tender all holdings. Offer period through 2026-09-30, conditional on shareholder approval of share consolidation.
summary_jp: 買付予定数を9,286,037株に変更（最低3,768,300株）。買付価格4,790円/株。NECは保有株式の応募を見送り、EM Systemsと日本事務器は全株応募予定。2026年9月30日終了予定。株式併合承認が条件。

summary_en: Tender offer minimum revised from 4,968,300 shares (29.79% S/O) to 3,768,300 shares (22.60% S/O) following NEC's execution of non-acceptance contract; NEC (1,200,000 shares held, 7.20% S/O) will not tender and will abstain on share consolidation vote. SK-03 Co. tender price ¥1,650/share. Offer period 6 Aug – 17 Sept 2026.
summary_jp: NEC不応募契約の締結に伴い買付予定数の下限を4,968,300株から3,768,300株に引き下げ。NEC保有株（1,200,000株、7.20%）は応募しない。SK-03株式会社による公開買付け価格1,650円/株、期間2026年8月6日～9月17日。

summary_en: CE Holdings to conduct self-tender offer for treasury shares following planned delisting by SK-03 fund-backed acquisition group. Size and price ceiling not yet disclosed in board resolution. Execution contingent on third-party tender offer completion and extraordinary shareholder approval of share consolidation. Open-market or ToSTNeT-3 method. Purpose: fund consolidation post-MBO squeeze-out.
summary_jp: SK-03買収グループによる上場廃止予定に伴い、CEホールディングスが自社株公開買付けを実施予定。規模・上限価格は未開示。第三者による買付成立および定款変更（単元株式数廃止）の承認を条件。ToSTNeT-3または立会外方式。MBO後スクイーズアウト資金調達目的。
tag_en: Buyback - size not disclosed - ToSTNeT-3 / open market - post-MBO squeeze-out - Conditional on SK-03 tender completion
tag_jp: 自己株式取得 - 規模未開示 - ToSTNeT-3/立会外 - MBO後スクイーズアウト - SK-03買付成立を条件

summary_en: Minimum 4,968,300 shares (29.9% of S/O ex-treasury) at ¥1,650/share. Tender period Aug 6 – Sep 17, 2026 (30 business days). No upper limit disclosed. Offeror SK-03 K.K. (100% held by SK-02 K.K.) intends to make CE Holdings a wholly owned subsidiary and delist it. Board supports the offer but takes neutral stance on shareholder tendering decisions. Parallel acquisition from CEO Sugimoto of 1,450,800 restricted shares (8.70% S/O) at settlement subject to minimum threshold achievement.
summary_jp: 下限4,968,300株（29.9%）、1,650円/株。2026年8月6日～9月17日（30営業日）。上限未開示。SK-03株式会社による完全子会社化・上場廃止を目的とした買付け。取締役会は賛同、応募は中立。CEO杉本氏からの並行買付け（制限付き1,450,800株、8.70%）は決済時に実施予定。
tag_en: MBO – SK-03 K.K. tender offer – 4,968,300 shares minimum (29.9% S/O) – ¥1,650/share – Aug 6 – Sep 17, 2026 – Delisting planned
tag_jp: MBO – SK-03株式会社による公開買付け – 下限4,968,300株（29.9%）– 1,650円/株 – 2026年8月6日～9月17日 – 上場廃止予定
